plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

response.text:
SF10 robot stop output | outputsGoLow | dual outputs | configured for a robot stop output and a robot stop is initiated | When configured for a robot stop output and there is a robot stop, the dual outputs are LOW
SF10 robot stop output | outputsGoHigh | dual outputs | no robot stop is initiated | If there is no robot stop initiated, dual outputs are high
SF10 robot stop output | toleratesPulses | output pulses | pulses are not used | Pulses are not used but they are tolerated
SF10 external Estop | changesDualOutputs | dual outputs | external Estop is connected to a configurable safety input configured as an Emergency Stop input | These dual outputs change state for any external Estop that is connected to configurable safety inputs where this input is configured as an Emergency Stop input
SF10 stop output | isNotConnectedTo | IMMI (Injection Moulding Machine Interface) | to prevent having an unrecoverable stop | This stop output is not connected to the IMMI (Injection Moulding Machine Interface), to prevent having an unrecoverable stop
SF10 stop output | requiresValidationAt | external connection to external equipment | | For the Stop Output, validation is performed at the external connection to external equipment
SF11 moving safety function | outputsGoLow | dual digital outputs | robot is moving (motion underway) | Whenever the robot is moving (motion underway), the dual digital outputs are LOW
SF11 moving safety function | outputsGoHigh | dual digital outputs | no movement | Outputs are HIGH when no movement
SF12 not stopping safety function | outputsGoHigh | dual digital outputs | robot is stopping (in process of stopping or in a stand-still condition) | Whenever the robot is STOPPING (in process of stopping or in a stand-still condition) the dual digital outputs are HIGH
SF13 reduced active safety function | outputsGoLow | dual digital outputs | reduced settings are active (or initiated) for safety functions | When reduced settings are active (or initiated) for safety functions, the dual digital outputs are LOW
SF14 reduced not active safety function | outputsGoLow | dual digital outputs | reduced settings are NOT active (or not initiated) | Whenever the robot reduced settings for safety functions are NOT active (or not initiated), the digital outputs are LOW
functional safety rating | coversOnly | what is within the UR robot | | Functional safety is for what is within the UR robot
